meta.database_name: NL Injury Tracker — Star Player Updates
meta.description: Community-maintained MLB injury database tracking National League stars. Initial data file compiled from latest reports.

ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

current_injury.type: Left hamstring strain (Grade 1, 2nd occurrence); left fibula non-displaced fracture (resolved)
current_injury.mechanism: Hamstring: strained running to first base vs. White Sox. Fibula: non-displaced fracture suffered in Spring Training (Mar 3, 2026).
current_injury.severity: Moderate — hamstring recurring; fibula fracture fully resolved
current_injury.details: Left hamstring strain placed on 10-day IL on June 9, 2025. After extensive FCL rehab and cleared for all rehab gates, Acuña has progressed to Triple-A Gwinnett. Fibula fracture rehab started April 2026 and is now complete. All rehab gates cleared.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 ACL tear. All rehab gates cleared — playing at Triple-A Gwinnett. Expected return during Braves homestand ending July 23. Any setback during live game action could still push return. Braves confirmed no plan to move Acuña to shortstop despite Ha-Seong Kim injury. Manager Walt Weiss: 'He's probably as strong as he's ever been. When he comes back, we want him to be able to go.'

latest_update.event: Scheduled for Triple-A Gwinnett games July 18–19. All rehab gates cleared. Expected to return July 22–23.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.type: Stiff lower back (Jul 11) + right wrist soreness (resolved Jul 2) + post-viral fatigue from Jul 2025 illness
current_injury.mechanism: Lower back stiffness — no specific incident. Wrist soreness resolved with treatment. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness (late July 2025 — ~25 lbs loss, 175→150 lbs).
current_injury.severity: Minor (day-to-day); NOT expected on IL for any current issue
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games as of Jul 13 for back stiffness. Manager Dave Roberts confirmed NOT expected on IL. Conservative day-to-day management. Residual fatigue from July 2025 viral illness. Currently on a 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15 games).

rehab_timeline.viral_care: Weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs; manager says 'turned a corner'

injury_history.return: Returned; 150 lbs, manager says 'turned a corner'

injury_history.type: Left ankle sprain + right back strain

mookie-betts.notes: Most tumultuous stretch in recent memory for a star. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected for back or wrist. Conservative treatment. 7-game hitting streak suggests return to form. Key timeline: Viral illness in late July 2025 → returned late March 2025 → oblique strain April 2026 → back stiffness July 2026.

latest_update.event: Back stiffness day-to-day; out 3+ games. 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15). Manager Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot — just managing day-to-day.'

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman

current_injury.type: No acute injury currently. Neck stinger resolved (Aug 2025). Chronic ankle managed with load management. Left wrist contusion (HBP) resolved.
current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger from neck into right shoulder during game vs. Reds. Chronic left ankle from previous sprains. Left wrist contusion from 88 mph sinker (HBP).
current_injury.severity: Mild (all resolved) / Moderate (chronic ankle — managed ongoing)
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle from June 2025 sprain managed with load management and treatment. Left wrist contusion from HBP resolved (X-rays negative). Left rib/scar tissue (Mar 2025) resolved. Currently playing regularly.

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups monitored

freddie-freeman.notes: Chronic ankle issues require ongoing load management. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS while playing through ankle surgery. Freeman is the most durable of the three tracked players. Lineup impact: moved to 2nd spot behind Ohtani after Betts' return. Dave Roberts: 'He feels a lot better. There's still some lingering effects, but nothing compromising... I feel confident he can get through it.' Pre-injury 2025 stats: .292 AVG, .836 OPS.

latest_update.event: Out vs. Reds with neck stinger; returned to lineup Friday. No IL. Chronic ankle managed. Currently active.
